doc.title: Marshall Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 19, 2021

title: Admiring Johnny Hodges
summary: Rowe notes Allen's 63 years with the band; Allen says he wanted to play like Johnny Hodges for his big beautiful tone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: You know we celebrate Freddie Green and Harry Carney for how long they stayed with Basie and Ellington, but you’ve got them beat by quite a bit.
Yeah. Well you know I admired all of those although I was looking up to them, I wanted to play like Johnny Hodges.
Yeah as a matter of fact, one of the well known critics described, “Here’s Marshall Allen’s playing as Johnny Hodges from another dimension.”
Yeah because I looked up to him because he had this big old big fat beautiful tone.
Yeah so he played so beautifully. I said that’s what I want to do.
